Course Discovery- Cart- PayOS Payment &: Completing payment via the PayOS QR flow confirms the payment through the webhook.
column3: 1. Continue from TC10. 2. Complete the payment on the PayOS side (sandbox/test payment). 3. Wait for the app to reflect the result.
column4: PayOS calls back `POST /api/v1/payment/payos-webhook`; the signature is verified via HMAC-SHA256; on a `"00"` success code the Payment status becomes SUCCESS and the app shows a Payment Success screen.
column5: A PENDING payment/QR from TC10 is active.

Course Discovery- Cart- PayOS Payment &: Checking out a Cart with multiple paid courses creates a single Payment covering all of them.
column3: 1. Add 2 different paid courses to the Cart. 2. Checkout together in one transaction. 3. Complete the PayOS payment.
column4: One Payment row is created whose courseIds covers both courses; on success, the webhook loops over both course IDs for enrollment/notification/cart-cleanup - both courses end up enrolled from a single payment.
column5: 2 different paid courses in the Cart.

Course Discovery- Cart- PayOS Payment &: A duplicated webhook delivery for the same payment does not create duplicate Enrollments or revenue records.
column3: 1. Complete a successful payment as in TC11. 2. Re-send/replay the exact same webhook payload a second time (simulating a PayOS retry).
column4: The webhook handler short-circuits because the Payment is already SUCCESS (pessimistic lock on txnRef); no second Enrollment, no duplicate revenue record, no duplicate notification is created.
column5: A payment already confirmed SUCCESS from TC11.

Course Discovery- Cart- PayOS Payment &: A webhook with an invalid/tampered HMAC signature is rejected without touching the Payment.
column3: 1. Send a webhook payload for a valid PENDING payment but with an altered/incorrect signature field.
column4: The request is rejected; the Payment row's status is untouched (remains PENDING); no Enrollment is created.
column5: A PENDING payment exists.
column15: Requires crafting the webhook payload directly (see integration_test_plan.md 3.5) since real PayOS won't sign a tampered payload for you.

Course Discovery- Cart- PayOS Payment &: A PENDING payment left unpaid for over 30 minutes is auto-expired by the background scheduler.
column3: 1. Create a Payment via Checkout and do NOT complete it in PayOS. 2. Wait (or seed a PENDING payment with a created_at over 30 minutes old directly for test speed). 3. Wait for the next 15-minute scheduler tick.
column4: `PaymentExpirationScheduler` flips the payment's status away from PENDING (expired); the Learner's payment status view reflects the expiry; no Enrollment is created for it.
column5: A PENDING payment older than 30 minutes exists.
